content_html:
#BadrinathkiDulhania : I do generally start speaking about only good points of the movie, but I cannot hold back myself from being LOL of the pathetic reality that the whole plot of movie revolves around Women Empowerment and against the Dowry system and how the Mard Varun becomes a real hero under the guidance of Alia, then why the hell the movie is named Badrinath ki Dulhania Vaidehi Ka Dulha should have been apt title for the movie.

These are the small points which prove that we are still in male dominated industry and the words like women empowerment are just to preach!!! way to go Dharma Productions and KoJo _/\_

Story deals with Dowry and Women Empowerment…..many may feel the movie’s story and screenplay is someting out from the 90’s. But thats what still happens in many places/families in India.

Kudos to Varun Dhawan for choosing this subject. Varun has clearly done justification to the good tapori from Jhansi. It has been a cakewalk for Alia, nothing much to challange the potential of the lill dynamite.

The plot of the movie is excellent but the way it is dealt in complete commercial manner has played a spoil sport. At the end of the day you neither get a feeling of watching a great story oriented movie nor a pakka commercial entertainer.

If you watch the movie for its realistic story line, the way it has been dealt will make you feel pathetic and if you watch it as a pakka commercial film then the story line looks pathetic
